questions.question: Will Serbia's National Assembly elect a prime minister from, or nominated by, the Student List by 31 January 2027?
questions.question_cs: Zvolí srbský parlament do 31. ledna 2027 premiérem člena Studentské kandidátky nebo jejího nominanta?
questions.criterion: Yes if, by 31 Jan 2027 23:59 CET, the National Assembly of Serbia elects a Prime Minister who is a member of, or was nominated by, the Student List, as recorded by the National Assembly (parlament.gov.rs) or reported by two major outlets. Otherwise no.
questions.criterion_cs: Ano, pokud do 31. ledna 2027 ve 23:59 SEČ Národní shromáždění Srbska zvolí předsedou vlády člena Studentské kandidátky nebo osobu, kterou tato kandidátka navrhla, podle záznamu Národního shromáždění (parlament.gov.rs) nebo zpráv dvou velkých médií. Jinak ne.
questions.background: The Student List, which grew out of nearly two years of student-led protests, won the snap parliamentary election of 25 October 2026 with a projected majority of about 140 of 250 seats; Aleksandar Vučić, who had resigned as president to run for prime minister, conceded defeat. questions.criterion: YES if on 3 Nov 2026 employees of ČT or ČRo stop work in a strike or warning strike against the bill abolishing the licence fees, as reported by ČTK, ČT24, iROZHLAS or another major Czech outlet. A symbolic action without a work stoppage (a statement only, a broadcast continuing as normal with a symbol on screen, or a rally outside working hours) does not count. NO otherwise, including if the strike is called off or postponed.

Symbolická akce bez přerušení práce (pouhé prohlášení, vysílání beze změny se symbolem na obrazovce nebo shromáždění mimo pracovní dobu) se nepočítá. questions.question: Will the EU formally name Christine Lagarde's successor as ECB President by 31 December 2026?
questions.question_cs: Určí EU formálně do 31. prosince 2026 nástupce Christine Lagarde v čele ECB?
questions.criterion: Yes if, by 31 Dec 2026 23:59 CET, a press release or conclusions on consilium.europa.eu (or the Official Journal) record either (a) the Council of the EU adopting its recommendation to the European Council naming a specific candidate for President of the ECB, or (b) the European Council adopting a decision appointing the next ECB President under Article 283(2) TFEU. A Eurogroup agreement, leaders' political endorsement or press reports alone do not count. Otherwise no.
questions.criterion_cs: Ano, pokud do 31. 12. 2026 23:59 SEČ tisková zpráva nebo závěry na consilium.europa.eu (nebo Úřední věstník EU) zaznamenají buď (a) přijetí doporučení Rady EU Evropské radě, které jmenovitě uvádí kandidáta na prezidenta ECB, nebo (b) přijetí rozhodnutí Evropské rady o jmenování příštího prezidenta ECB podle čl. 283 odst. 2 SFEU. Samotná dohoda Euroskupiny, politická podpora lídrů nebo zprávy médií se nepočítají. Jinak ne.
questions.background: On 29 Oct 2026 the ECB announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February 2027, nine months before the end of her term. Under Article 283(2) TFEU the European Council appoints her successor by qualified majority on a recommendation of the Council, after consulting the European Parliament and the ECB Governing Council. European Council President António Costa said the process would start immediately; Klaas Knot (backed by the Netherlands) and Pablo Hernández de Cos (backed by Spain) are named as front-runners.
